original.statement: Istio adds the env var SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO_JITTER (default 0.01), which randomizes certificate renewal timing by about +/- 15 minutes around the 12-hour renewal.

decision.reason: [ev-d0223398edc4] says `SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO_JITTER` was "Added" with a default value of `0.01`, so the change type "added" with after "0.01" fits the text. The evidence calls it a "configuration" but does not literally say it is an environment variable. The env-var family is an inference from the UPPER_SNAKE name and its pairing with `SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO`. That is why confidence is low.
